description: This file is an HTML document that sets up a web-based code editor using CodeMirror configured for editing COBOL source code. It includes references to external CSS and JavaScript resources, and provides a sample COBOL program within a <textarea> element.

methods.name: selectTheme
methods.description: Changes the theme of the CodeMirror editor based on user selection.

methods.name: selectFontsize
methods.description: Adjusts the font size of the editor based on user input.

methods.name: selectReadOnly
methods.description: Toggles the read-only mode of the editor.

methods.name: tabToIndentSpace
methods.description: Configures tab behavior to insert spaces or tabs in the editor.
